name: Avalon Marsh
lore: Avalon Marsh, round the Isle where Arthur sleeps. Caer Witrin stands on its island of apples, the Drowned Vigil still holds its keep in the north-west, and the black barge that carried the King is crossing again by night - for Morgana's people. In the west, Golestandt's giants lay a road of Cornish granite toward the Isle.

chains.title: The Ghoul Court
chains.hint: Torches burn in the drowned ruins...

stages.name: Clear Drowned Court
stages.objective: Clear the drowned court
stages.announce: The ghoul lord holds court in the drowned ruins and sends his knights to raid the causeway. End his court.
stages.success: You have cleared the drowned court. The Ghoul Lord of Avalon comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the drowned court. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Ghoul Lord of Avalon
stages.objective: Defeat the Ghoul Lord of Avalon
stages.announce: The Ghoul Lord of Avalon stands at the drowned court. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Ghoul Lord of Avalon falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: The Ghoul Lord of Avalon slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Ghouls Hold the Causeway
stages.objective: Drive the ghouls off the causeway
stages.announce: The ghoul lord's knights have come out of the drowned court and hold the causeway to Caer Witrin.
stages.success: The causeway is clear. The marsh is already pulling at the stones.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Brother Anselm, who is blessing the causeway stones
stages.announce: Brother Anselm is blessing the causeway stones. The dead are coming back!
stages.thanks: "Rest now, all of you. The causeway is holy ground again."
stages.success: The ghoul footmans break and scatter. The road to Caer Witrin is open again.
stages.fail: Brother Anselm falls, and the ghoul footmans take the road back.

stages.name: Protect Sister Enid
stages.objective: Protect Sister Enid, who is gathering healing herbs
stages.announce: Sister Enid of Caer Witrin is gathering herbs for the sick, and the bogmen have smelled her.
stages.success: "That's done," says Sister Enid. "They came from over there - let's finish this."
stages.fail: Sister Enid falls. The attackers are left to do as they please - for now.

stages.name: Clear Herb Beds
stages.objective: Clear the herb beds
stages.announce: They came from the herb beds. Follow them back and clear it out.
stages.success: You have cleared the herb beds. Mudgrip the Bog-Chief comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the herb beds. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Mudgrip the Bog-Chief
stages.objective: Defeat Mudgrip the Bog-Chief
stages.announce: Mudgrip the Bog-Chief stands at the herb beds. Bring friends.
stages.success: Mudgrip the Bog-Chief falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Mudgrip the Bog-Chief slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Bogman Gatherers Hold the Road to Adibard's Retreat
stages.objective: Drive the bogman gatherers off the road to Adibard's Retreat
stages.announce: With The Bogmen lost, the bogman gatherers have spread down onto the road to Adibard's Retreat and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The bogman gatherers are gone from the road to Adibard's Retreat. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Mabyn, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Mabyn has come out to set the road to Adibard's Retreat right. The bogman gatherers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Adibard's Retreat is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The bogman gatherers break and scatter. The road to Adibard's Retreat is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Mabyn falls, and the bogman gatherers take the road back.

chains.title: Shamblers of the Marsh
chains.hint: Guardian Sergeant Lyle is looking for help in Caer Witrin.

giver.name: Guardian Sergeant Lyle
giver.greet: Shamblers have risen out of the mire and broken the west causeway. I'm taking my guardians out to clear them. Will you come? Tell me when you're [ready].
giver.reply: Good. Stay close - they will have watchers out. With me!
giver.busy: We've only just come back. Give my people a while to rest, then find me again.

stages.name: The Road to Sinking Causeway
stages.objective: Go with Guardian Sergeant Lyle to the sinking causeway
stages.announce: Sergeant Lyle leads the guardians of Caer Witrin out onto the marsh.
stages.success: Guardian Sergeant Lyle reaches the sinking causeway. "There they are. Clear them out!"
stages.fail: Guardian Sergeant Lyle falls on the road. The others carry the body home.

stages.name: Clear Sinking Causeway
stages.objective: Clear the sinking causeway
stages.announce: Clear the sinking causeway!
stages.success: You have cleared the sinking causeway. The Mire Colossus comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the sinking causeway. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: The Mire Colossus
stages.objective: Defeat the Mire Colossus
stages.announce: The Mire Colossus stands at the sinking causeway. Bring friends.
stages.success: The Mire Colossus falls. Caer Witrin will hear of this in the taverns tonight.
stages.fail: The Mire Colossus slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Shamblers Hold the Road to Caer Witrin
stages.objective: Drive the shamblers off the road to Caer Witrin
stages.announce: With Shamblers of the Marsh lost, the shamblers have spread down onto the road to Caer Witrin and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The shamblers are gone from the road to Caer Witrin. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Hal, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Hal has come out to set the road to Caer Witrin right. The shamblers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Caer Witrin is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The shamblers break and scatter. The road to Caer Witrin is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Hal falls, and the shamblers take the road back.

chains.title: The Leapers' Pool
chains.hint: Something drags the marsh-men under at the dark pool...

stages.name: Clear Leapers' Pool
stages.objective: Clear the leapers' pool
stages.announce: Water leapers have taken the dark pool in the marsh, and they pull down anyone who comes to fish it. End them.
stages.success: You have cleared the leapers' pool. Grandfather Leaper comes out to fight.
stages.fail: They hold the leapers' pool. They will be bolder next time.

stages.name: Grandfather Leaper
stages.objective: Defeat Grandfather Leaper
stages.announce: Grandfather Leaper stands at the leapers' pool. Bring friends.
stages.success: Grandfather Leaper falls. The way is safe again.
stages.fail: Grandfather Leaper slips away - for now.

stages.name: The Water Leapers Hold the Road to Caer Witrin
stages.objective: Drive the water leapers off the road to Caer Witrin
stages.announce: With The Leapers' Pool lost, the water leapers have spread down onto the road to Caer Witrin and stop anyone who passes. They will stay until someone drives them out.
stages.success: The water leapers are gone from the road to Caer Witrin. It will need setting right.

stages.name: Set It Right
stages.objective: Protect Roadwarden Hal, who is clearing the road and putting up a new waymarker
stages.announce: Roadwarden Hal has come out to set the road to Caer Witrin right. The water leapers are coming back for it!
stages.thanks: "That's done - the road to Caer Witrin is safe again. Thank you."
stages.success: The water leapers break and scatter. The road to Caer Witrin is open again.
stages.fail: Roadwarden Hal falls, and the water leapers take the road back.

chains.title: The Black Barge
chains.hint: No moon tonight - and a long black boat is sliding through the mist toward the Isle...

stages.name: The Mist
stages.objective: Cut through the mist round the landing
stages.announce: The black barge is crossing to the Isle with Morgana's people aboard, and the mist round the landing has turned on everyone. Get to the landing!
stages.success: The mist thins. The barge grinds onto the landing, and its oarsmen stand up.
stages.fail: The barge reaches the Isle.

stages.name: the Oarsmaster
stages.objective: Defeat the barge's Oarsmaster
stages.announce: The Oarsmaster, drowned three hundred years, lifts his oar like a spear: 'We row for the key and the crown.' Bring friends.
stages.success: The Oarsmaster falls back into the water, and the barge drifts empty on the mist.
stages.fail: The barge lands its passengers on the Isle.

chains.title: Retake the Vigil Keep
chains.hint: Warden-Sergeant Cai is gathering the Marsh Wardens east of the Drowned Vigil's keep.

giver.name: Warden-Sergeant Cai
giver.greet: The Vigil's held that keep for three hundred years with nobody to relieve them. We're the relief. Four at least, bots and all - say [relieve the Vigil].
giver.reply: Through the walls! Hold the gate, the chapel and the tower, and put down whoever commands them!
giver.thanks: The Vigil Keep is ours! They're relieved!
giver.regret: Back into the reeds! We'll come again.

stages.name: The Walls
stages.objective: Cut through the Vigil's dead on the walls
stages.announce: Over the walls! The Vigil's dead are turning out to meet us, in good order, as they always did!
stages.success: The walls are ours. The ghouls fall back to the gate, the chapel and the tower.
stages.fail: The wardens are thrown back into the reeds.

stages.name: Gate, Chapel and Tower
stages.objective: Hold the gate, the chapel and the tower at once
stages.announce: The Vigil hold three posts - the gate, the chapel and the tower. Stand on all three at once and they'll know they've been relieved!
stages.success: The posts are relieved - and the Vigil's marshal comes out of the keep to see who dares.
stages.fail: The Vigil drive the wardens off their posts.

stages.name: Ghoul-Marshal Vrask
stages.objective: Defeat Ghoul-Marshal Vrask
stages.announce: Ghoul-Marshal Vrask, in drowned plate: 'No relief came. No relief will come. Stand to!'
stages.success: Vrask falls - and with him, every ghoul on the walls lowers its weapon. 'Relieved,' something whispers. The Marsh Wardens raise their banner on the tower.
stages.fail: Vrask holds the keep.

chains.title: The Drowned Lord-Commander
chains.hint: The water round the Vigil Keep is rising, and something is walking up out of it.

stages.name: The Chapel
stages.objective: Keep Warden-Chaplain Mabon alive in the chapel
stages.announce: The drowned are coming up out of the marsh round the keep - the whole Vigil, three hundred years of it. Hold the chapel!
stages.success: The first rush breaks - and the Lord-Commander walks up out of the water.
stages.fail: Mabon falls in the chapel.

stages.name: the Drowned Lord-Commander
stages.objective: Defeat the Drowned Lord-Commander
stages.announce: The Drowned Lord-Commander, streaming marsh-water: 'Who relieved my Vigil without my order?'
stages.success: The Lord-Commander sinks back into the marsh. The keep holds - for now.
stages.fail: The Vigil take their keep back.

siege.name: the Vigil Keep
siege.open_text: Hear me! The Marsh Wardens mean to relieve the Drowned Vigil and take their keep! Warden-Sergeant Cai waits in the reeds east of the keep. If no one leads within the half-hour, the Wardens go without you.
siege.taken_text: The Vigil Keep is ours! The Marsh Wardens' banner flies on the tower and the Vigil are relieved - go and see.
siege.repelled_text: The Wardens have been thrown back from the Vigil Keep. The drowned grow bolder.
siege.raid_text: The water is rising round the Vigil Keep: the drowned are coming back for it!
siege.held_text: The drowned are thrown back into the marsh. The keep holds.
siege.fall_text: The Vigil Keep has fallen to the Drowned Lord-Commander. The Wardens must rebuild their resolve.
siege.carry_text: Warden-Sergeant Cai leads you through the reeds at a run.
siege.carried_cry: The Wardens wouldn't wait any longer - they have stormed {0}!

camp_npcs.name: Warden-Quartermaster Ysbail
camp_npcs.greet: The keep's stores - what three hundred years of damp didn't ruin, and what we brought. For the relief.

camp_npcs.name: Apple-Wife Morfydd
camp_npcs.greet: Cider and cures from Caer Witrin's orchards. Coin, if you please.

camp_npcs.name: marsh warden
camp_npcs.idle: Three hundred years they stood here. I've done three hours and my feet are wet.
